name: MegaMenu
description: A mega menu: a navbar item that opens a wide panel of grouped links, under its trigger or across the full width of the navbar, following the WAI-ARIA disclosure navigation pattern. On small screens the panel stacks in the collapsed navbar.
import: import { MegaMenu, MegaMenuContent, MegaMenuGroup, MegaMenuLink, MegaMenuTrigger } from "@stefan-florescu/ui";
useWhen: A navbar item that leads to many pages, grouped in columns
Navigation links with icons or one-line descriptions
A navigation panel with a call to action or a promotional card next to the links
avoidWhen: A short list of links under a navbar item: use Dropdown with DropdownContent
Actions or options (not navigation): use Dropdown with DropdownMenu
Site navigation in a side panel: use Drawer
